name: Major cyber incidents
summary: Record Binance theft; Polymarket halted trading after a supply-chain hack; alert apps hit 2 Nov
state: The FBI says North Korea stole about $6.3bn from Binance in late October, the largest crypto theft on record; Pyongyang denied it on 3 Nov. Polymarket suspended trading after attackers compromised a third-party service to push crypto-draining code, and attackers are exploiting a maximum-severity GitLab flaw (BleepingComputer). On 2 Nov alert apps in Russia and Ukraine sent false warnings after cyberattacks.
for_you: Be alert to phishing linked to data-breach news; NCSC guidance covers how to protect accounts.
rubric_hit: Attacks disrupting a major exchange and public services = Watch; none national-scale

sources.title: CNBC — North Korea denies links to Binance hack
PBS — Ukraine and Russia report fake emergency alerts

why: Ransomware and state hacking now shut down hospitals, retailers, carmakers and airports for weeks.
drivers: Ransomware gangs, state actors, zero-days, supply-chain compromises.

rubric.alert: National-scale attack on critical infrastructure (power, health, finance), or a destructive state-attributed attack.
rubric.watch: Ransomware or attack disrupting a large company or critical service, or a mass-exploited zero-day.
rubric.normal: No major incidents disrupting critical services this week.
